liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Near the end of the second verse of Dark Star out of Space, the listener thought the band was about to enter St. Stephen; Reviewer also heard a St. Stephen tease during Dark Star; another tease after Eyes remains unidentified [34][44]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 review): Reviewer calls Wang Dang Doodle exemplary, among the strong opening three songs of set one [39]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Reviewer puzzled by something odd going on during Cumberland Blues, crediting BH's mixing work [38]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Reviewer calls this their favorite Good Lovin' from the post-Brent era [38]
- **We Bid You Goodnight** (1 review): Attendee recalls it as the last We Bid You Goodnight they ever saw [43]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-09-26.schoeps.andrewf.84853.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 161 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: A minor low-end rumble is audible at times, possibly from ventilation blowing onto the microphones [1]
- **gd1991-09-26.aud.andrewf.84852.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 161 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: A minor low-end rumble is audible at times, possibly from ventilation blowing onto the microphones [2]
- **gd1991-09-26.153422.mtx.photoleon.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 161 min [4]
- **gd91-09-26.sbd.fishman.21242.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 144 min; rated 4.33/5 by 21 [8]. Said about its sound: Vocals suffer from serious flutter on this recording [39]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Boston Garden's final Dead show was 10/3/94; fall 1995 wristbands were scheduled for August 9, 1995 but never distributed [40]
- Attendee, at roughly their 50th show, says it was the first and only time they saw Dark Star live [43]
- Reviewer says this was not the last Boston Garden show and rates a later acoustic Looks Like Rain Eyes better than this St. Eyes [37]
- Reviewer found the first set solid but the second set far better, magical [42]
- Reviewer saw six Boston shows in this era and ranked this one favorite, largely for the song list [44]
- Reviewer, after about 300 shows, ranks this among the best of the later era [45]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-09-26.schoeps.andrewf.84853.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (ORTF) > unknown power supply > Panasonic SV-255 (lead deck) > Coax SPDIF > Casio DA-7 Dat (first deck out) > Agfa Dat tape. Mics on 7-foot… [1]
- **gd1991-09-26.aud.andrewf.84852.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (ORTF) > unknown power supply > Panasonic SV-255 (lead deck) > Coax SPDIF > Casio DA-7 Dat (first deck out) > Agfa Dat tape. Mics on 7-foot… [2]
- **gd1991-09-26.153422.mtx.photoleon.flac16**: source: A photoLeon Matrix [4]. Also: Matrix made in Adobe Audition by Joe Noel from a soundboard and a front-of-board recording plus an audience tape; One source was pitch corrected, and another soundboard supplies a three-minute patch in a set-two track [4]
- **gd91-09-26.sbd.fishman.21242.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD(1)>DAT>CD>EAC>CDWAVE>MKWACT>SHNThis may be a digital soundboard. There is no wow and flutter in Eyes of the World as existed in older versions of the… [8]. Also: Correct lineage given as SBD to DAT to Cm to DAT to CD; reviewer says it is not a digital soundboard [41]
